thread:
mira: Pushed a docs PR to reconcile SOC2 language for audit streams, retention, and keys. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1215
syl: Quick skim looks good. Legal asked we avoid vague phrasing like 'as required' and include a numeric default retention. Also clarify auditor access flow.
kevin: Ops note: Dedicated and Private customers can set retention per-tenant; add a migration blurb and an example using the ops export tool.
aurora-legal: Prefer a single public default value. Recommend: 'Default audit log retention: 90 days. Extended retention (up to 7 years) available by contract.' Also require auditor access to be request+SOW, time-limited, identity-verified, and logged.
mira: I updated the PR to: "Default audit log retention is 90 days. Extended retention up to 7 years is available via customer agreement." Added bullet on auditor access: "Granted via support ticket + SOW, access is time-limited and auditor actions are recorded."
syl: Technical nit: don't state 'PII is redacted before any processing'. Use: "Automated PII detection and masking occur during ingestion; detected PII is masked prior to long-term storage. Transient processing buffers may contain unmasked tokens for short-lived compute; these are encrypted and access-controlled."
kevin: Added a Dedicated migration snippet suggestion: `rw-ops export-retention --tenant=acme > acme-retention.yaml` and a note to contact ops@redwood.ai for migration help.
mira: I also added a small SDK example for opting out of request-level audit logs (Go):
```go
// disable audit logging for local dev
client := redwood.New(redwood.Config{APIKey: os.Getenv("RW_KEY"), Options: redwood.Options{AuditEnabled: false}})
```
aurora-legal: One more: avoid the bare term 'HSM'  prefer 'KMS/HSM' and call out that customer-managed keys are supported on Private/Dedicated; Hosted uses Redwood-managed keys unless contract specifies otherwise.
syl: Ran the docs linter: doc-bot should pick this up, but looks ready pending legal sign-off on the exact retention phrase.
doc-bot: docs-ci: lint passed for PR #1215  warnings: frontmatter.productArea missing.
mira: I'll fix the frontmatter warning and wait for legal OK. Thanks everyone.
